text: Jessica Love's Julián Is a Mermaid was removed from all libraries by Clay County School District, after a Challenge Oversight Committee claimed that the story violated Florida's obscenity law. At a DoDEA elementary school in Italy, the book was removed from the library in response to the EOs. Darien Public Schools deemed it appropriate after some in the Darien, CT, community questioned it, and it remained available to teachers. A committee voted to keep it on shelves after Olivia Haley petitioned to remove it, finding no specific references to sex or gender in the book. The St. Tammany Library Board of Conduct also voted to keep it on library shelves after it was challenged for its subject matter.
meta_description: Julián Is a Mermaid by Jessica Love: removed from all libraries in Clay County, removed at a DoDEA school in Italy, and kept after challenges elsewhere.
